GpuQualitySection.description:
Step up to a bigger GPU model for medium requests, when it can be loaded.

The quality backend is *not* a failover: if it cannot be loaded (VRAM taken by another
process, e.g. a Jellyfin transcode), the request goes back to the fast GPU model and the
quality model is left alone for ``retry_after_s``.

min_chars.title: Min Chars

keywords.title: Keywords

retry_after_s.description: Pause after a failed load before trying the quality model again.
retry_after_s.title: Retry After S

GpuQualitySection.title: GpuQualitySection

ToolsSection.description:
Tool families offered to each tier, by tag.

A tool is offered to a tier only when *every* tag of the tool is listed for that tier
(a tool with a new, unlisted tag is therefore hidden by default). Tags: ha (read Home
Assistant), action (act on the house), camera, routines, routine_edit, memory,
memory_edit, internal (escalate), web (web_search / web_fetch).
